Bramble.look: Bramble the little blue bunny with soft blue fur and floppy ears

Pip.look: Pip the tiny yellow duckling with bright orange feet

series.title: Garden Tales with Bramble
series.logline: Gentle little adventures about sharing and kindness in a sunny garden.

episodes.title: Bramble's Big Blue Balloon
episodes.summary: Bramble the blue bunny finds a red balloon and learns the joy of sharing it with Pip the yellow duckling. Together, they watch it dance in the breeze as a new day begins.
